take: Chicago announced that it recalled C Dominic Toninato from Rockford (AHL) and placed F Andrew Mangiapane on injured reserve. Mangiapane was a fourth-line forward at 5:23 a night, and in the five games since he went out, Teuvo Teravainen has taken his spot beside Bertuzzi and Frondell while Roman Kantserov has moved up to 18:38 a night from 17:07. Toninato has played three games this season at 8:87 a night without a point, and Chicago has controlled just 43 percent of the expected goals (the quality of chances) in its 3-6-0 start.
